Important information

Safety Information

If the product is dropped, the brush head should be replaced before the next use even if no damage is visible. Do not use as a toy or without adult supervision. Small parts may pose choking hazard. Do not chew or bite on brush. For cleaning, switch off the handle and remove the brush head. Rinse both parts separately with water and wipe them dry before reassembling. DISPOSE OR RECYCLE BATTERIES IN ACCORDANCE WITH LOCAL REGULATIONS. DO NOT USE ON CHILDREN UNDER AGE 3. PRIOR TO USE, ENSURE THE BRUSH HEAD FITS WELL. REPLACE BRUSH HEAD EVERY 3 MONTHS OR SOONER IF BRUSH HEAD BECOMES WORN OR NO LONGER FITS PROPERLY.

Product Description

Power up to a better clean with the Oral-B Pro 100 CrossAction Battery Toothbrush featuring perfectly angled bristles to get deep between teeth. Improve your oral health by removing more plaque than a regular manual toothbrush with each use. 2 AA Batteries included. Replace brush head every 3 months. Compatible with other Oral-B Brush Heads: CrossAction, Sensitive Gum Care, FlossAction, 3D White.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customers say

Customers find this toothbrush to be the best they've used, with good cleaning performance that leaves their mouth feeling clean for hours. The battery life lasts about a month between changes, and one customer notes the circular brushing action makes a noticeable difference. While some say it works almost as well as an electric toothbrush, others report it stops working, and opinions about value for money are divided between those who find it worth the price and those who consider it a waste of money. The durability and power receive mixed reviews, with some saying it doesn't last and the motor weakens over time, while noise level is a concern as customers find it a bit loud.

Amazon Customer
5 out of 5 stars
Makes it feel like you just left the dentist!
I’m honestly impressed with how effective this toothbrush is at cleaning my teeth. After every use, my teeth feel like I just left the dentist — super polished and completely grit-free. It gives that professional clean feeling you don’t usually get at home. It’s also a great value for the cost. One thing I really appreciate is that the battery is easy to change. Unlike other models that require special chargers or hard-to-find batteries, this one uses standard AA batteries — and it even comes with a pair included, which is a nice bonus. I’ve used non-circular bristles for years and decided to try the circular motion design this time. I honestly regret not switching sooner. The circular brushing action makes a noticeable difference in how clean my teeth feel. Highly recommend if you’re looking for an affordable upgrade that actually works!

    Reviewed in the United States on March 1, 2026

    I’ve been using this Oral-B Pro 100 CrossAction battery toothbrush for a while now and I’m really happy with it. It feels like a noticeable upgrade from a regular manual brush — my teeth feel cleaner and smoother after every use. The round brush head gets into areas that I usually miss, and the battery-powered action gives a deeper clean without making brushing cumbersome. The built-in 2-minute timer is a nice touch to help me stick to the dentist-recommended brushing time too.

    It’s lightweight, easy to use right out of the box (just pop in the batteries and you’re ready), and being compatible with various Oral-B heads means I can swap to softer or more advanced heads later if I want. For the price, it’s a reliable and practical daily toothbrush that genuinely improved my oral care routine.

About this Item

  • Oral-B Pro 100 CrossAction Battery powered toothbrush reaches deep for a superior plaque removal and healthier gums* *vs a regular manual toothbrush
  • CrossAction brush head features a round brush head for a tooth-by-tooth clean
  • Consistent battery performance. 2 AA batteries included
  • Compatible with other Oral-B Brush Heads: CrossAction, Sensitive, Gum Care, FlossAction, 3D White
  • Oral-B, #1 dentist-recommended toothbrush brand worldwide

Product Description

Power up to a better clean with the Oral-B Pro 100 CrossAction Battery Toothbrush featuring perfectly angled bristles to get deep between teeth. Improve your oral health by removing more plaque than a regular manual toothbrush with each use. 2 AA Batteries included. Replace brush head every 3 months. Compatible with other Oral-B Brush Heads: CrossAction, Sensitive Gum Care, FlossAction, 3D White.

Important Information

Safety Information

If the product is dropped, the brush head should be replaced before the next use even if no damage is visible. Do not use as a toy or without adult supervision. Small parts may pose choking hazard. Do not chew or bite on brush. For cleaning, switch off the handle and remove the brush head. Rinse both parts separately with water and wipe them dry before reassembling. DISPOSE OR RECYCLE BATTERIES IN ACCORDANCE WITH LOCAL REGULATIONS. DO NOT USE ON CHILDREN UNDER AGE 3. PRIOR TO USE, ENSURE THE BRUSH HEAD FITS WELL. REPLACE BRUSH HEAD EVERY 3 MONTHS OR SOONER IF BRUSH HEAD BECOMES WORN OR NO LONGER FITS PROPERLY.
